uprightDepthEvidence.reason: The original upright local-aligned smoke has legitimate pixels below its foot. Forcing the whole baked upright image to a ground depth plane makes those pixels remain on top of the floor as a flat patch. Preserve source RGBA and use upright depth so real floor occlusion can reject below-floor pixels.
